read_methods.structured: Generated inventories inspected by complete schema/record traversal, lossless repeated-value factoring and independent source-field comparison rather than interpreting digest strings as prose.

findings.finding: arms-paper-modeler metadata describes general derivation/model development although its supplied workflow performs production evaluation of a validated frozen method. The old builder recreates this scope error.
findings.action: Refine active metadata/routing and synchronize authored rebuild sources; preserve full source workflow.

findings.finding: Semantic route cases only assert membership within first5; source reachability by exact name does not prove primary selection or near-neighbor exclusion.
findings.action: Verify ranked primary and excluded-neighbor behavior with domain fixtures.

findings.finding: Existing33-test/32-pass receipts and environment snapshots are dated25Oct2026 historical evidence. Nested package-validation differs only in historical JSON count62 vs64.
findings.action: Preserve as historical, create fresh review-specific receipts after authorized implementation; do not relabel old checks current.

findings.finding: Catalog has117 source skills; active router is the118th entrypoint but absent from search inventory.
findings.action: Account router explicitly when generating complete118-entry mapping/catalog.

findings.finding: Development build copies into existing output/work trees with dirs_exist_ok and does not remove stale files, so source deletions/renames in a reused authoring workspace can persist in a later build.
findings.action: For fresh verification reconstruct/build in a new empty authoring workspace or explicitly validate exact expected payload set.
